999008199.text:
プラフタさん。設計の助けが必要かと思って、
リリーを連れてきたわ

localizations.en: Plachta, I brought Lilie along. I thought you might need some help with the design work.
Marion

999008199.text:
どこまで力になれるか分かりませんが、
あたしにも協力させてください！

localizations.en: I'm not sure how much I can contribute, but I'd like to help out too!
Lilie

999008199.text:
助かります。ではまず、広い世界の中で「飴」の存在を
検出する仕組みを検討したいのですが……

localizations.en: That would be much appreciated. First, I'd like to examine how we might detect the candies' presence across the entire world...
Plachta

999008199.text:
「飴」は元々転移用の道具。転移するのに
転移元の位置と、転移先の位置が必要となると……

localizations.en: The candies were originally designed for teleportation. Since teleporting requires knowing both your current position and your destination...
Lilie

999008199.text:
「飴」自体に現在位置を検出する機能がありそうよね。
それを上手く利用すれば……

localizations.en: The candies themselves probably have some kind of position-detection function built in. If we could make use of that...
Lilie

999008199.text: なるほど……その前提で検討してみましょう

localizations.en: I see... Let's proceed with that assumption.
Plachta

999008199.text:
二人とも、真剣だな。
俺たちも機材製作担当として頑張らないと

localizations.en: Those two are really focused. We'd better do our part with the equipment production.
Logy

999008199.text: ええ。新式錬金術の使い手同士、力を合わせましょう

localizations.en: Right. Let's combine our skills as practitioners of the New Alchemy.
Miruca

999008199.text:
お二人も、レシピを見て何か気付いたことがあったら
教えてもらえると助かります

localizations.en: If either of you notice anything while reviewing the recipe, please don't hesitate to point it out.
Plachta

999008199.text: 無駄な部分があればすぐに指摘するわ

localizations.en: I'll call out any unnecessary elements right away.
Miruca

999008199.text:
ユーディットさん、ついにできたよ！　
これが「宝石パイプ追跡イタズラ装置」だ！

localizations.en: Judie, we finally did it! Behold, the Gemstone Pipe Tracking Prank Device!
Suelle

999008199.text:
これでキースさんのパイプがある場所に、
直接「何か」を送り込めるはずだよね？

localizations.en: So with this, we should be able to send something directly to wherever Keithgriff's pipe is, right?
Judie

999008199.text:
ふふふ、どんなイタズラを仕掛ける？　やっぱり、
びっくり箱とか？　それとも……お菓子の山とか？

localizations.en: Hehe, what kind of prank should we pull? Maybe a jack-in-the-box? Or... a pile of sweets?
Suelle

999008199.text:
うーん、どうしようかな……あんまり怒らせると
怖いし、でもちょっとは驚かせたいし……

localizations.en: Hmm, I'm not sure... I don't want to make him too angry, but I do want to surprise him a little...
Judie

999008199.text:
そういえば、リアスさんから猫の耳が生える薬が
あるって聞いたような？

localizations.en: Oh yeah, didn't Rias mention something about a potion that makes cat ears grow?
Suelle

999008199.text: 猫の耳が生えたキースさん……見てみたいかも！

localizations.en: Keithgriff with cat ears... I kind of want to see that!
Judie

999008199.text:
よーし、決まり！
リアスさんからもらって、送り付けてやろう！

localizations.en: All right, it's decided! Let's get some from Rias and send it his way!
Suelle
